metadata.name: Voice Input
metadata.description: Press the voice key to record, then press again to transcribe and insert the text into the current app.

store.tagline: Press the voice key to speak, then press again to insert the text into the current app.
store.longDescription: Press the voice key to record, then press again to transcribe locally and insert the text into the current app. By default, Host keeps up to one hour of private rolling audio cache during the current runtime to recover speech from just before the key press. With all-day archiving enabled, speech heard by the keyboard is grouped by day in Context and daily summaries are generated automatically. Recordings stay on this computer and expire automatically; individual recordings can be deleted from their detail pages.

permissions.label: Permissions required
permissions.detail: Board USB HID does not need microphone permission; explicitly selected system input does. Accessibility permission is used to insert text into other apps.

recording.caption: Recording capsule: press once to start, then again to finish and insert text

attachContext.purpose: Use Send to agent in a Context segment header to attach this segment to an Agents·IM conversation input (A3-24).

accountStatus.purpose: Read only whether you are signed in to display availability of Voice cloud features and Agent. Does not read account details, tokens or subscription details.

cloudModel.purpose: Use your account credits to call Wainao models when selecting cloud recognition or using Voice Agent. Usage is billed.

voiceDeliver.purpose: Insert prepared text into the input field where the cursor is at that moment. Used for voice input, transcription and translation.

voiceContext.purpose: When polishing context is enabled, read text from the current input field to help AI match names and tone. Does not read window titles or file paths.

agentSession.purpose: Allow Voice to select Pi Agent or DSH Harness through the shared Agent service and use your account credits for commands and polishing.

audioCapture.purpose: Subscribes to the Host's shared audio so voice input can include what you said just before pressing the voice key

audioClips.purpose: Takes the shared audio from key press to release (plus about 1.5 seconds afterwards) and transcribes it on this computer; the clip is held only during this recognition and released right after

Records stay on this device and expire automatically; individual records can be deleted from their detail view.
